item.title: Repo Storyteller
item.description:
Problem it solves

AI can turn a repository into a fluent but unverifiable project story. Repo Storyteller gathers file, commit, and implementation evidence first, then separates facts, inferences, and unknowns so a tutorial, fork, or unfinished configuration is not presented as original delivery.

Core capabilities

  • Codex Skill plus deterministic Python analyzer, runnable without an API key;
  • Distinguishes forks, tutorials, reference implementations, and actual changes;
  • Produces evidence-linked architecture, decisions, risks, and project narratives;
  • Read-only by default, skips sensitive files, and optionally supports OpenAI-compatible summaries;
  • Evaluates output through risk recall and evidence coverage.
